name: second-opinion
description: Ask a panel of non-Anthropic models (through OpenRouter or a LiteLLM proxy) for an isolated second opinion on a plan, spec or hard design question

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: Key for https://openrouter.ai. Kept in secure storage. Left empty, the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable is used

litellmBaseUrl.title: LiteLLM proxy URL
litellmBaseUrl.description: Base URL of a LiteLLM proxy, such as http://localhost:4000. Left empty, the LITELLM_BASE_URL environment variable is used

litellmApiKey.title: LiteLLM API key
litellmApiKey.description: Virtual or master key for the LiteLLM proxy. Kept in secure storage. Left empty, the LITELLM_API_KEY environment variable is used

strongModels.title: Strong tier models
strongModels.description: Comma-separated provider/model refs in fallback order, such as openrouter/openai/gpt-5.6-sol or litellm/my-model. Add =high (or another thinking level) to a ref to set its reasoning effort

balancedModels.title: Balanced tier models
balancedModels.description: Comma-separated provider/model refs in fallback order, for the balanced tier

fastModels.title: Fast tier models
fastModels.description: Comma-separated provider/model refs in fallback order, for the fast tier (validation mode uses it)

defaultTier.title: Default tier
defaultTier.description: The tier a normal review draws reviewers from

reviewerCount.title: Reviewers per panel
reviewerCount.description: How many reviewers a normal review runs, 1 to 8. Validation mode always runs one

timeoutSeconds.title: Reviewer timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock limit for one reviewer. A reviewer past it counts as a failure, never an approval
